Steps.1: Check on schematic that 3V3 power rails supply the RS485 transceiver.
Steps.2: Connect the hw_DAA to a DAA CS harness.
Steps.3: Connect the power supply to the DAA CS harness power input, using a DC power connector, banana cables, and crocodile clips (according to the attached diagram).
Steps.4: Switch on the power supply source.
Steps.5: Set 6.5V on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.6: Turn on the CH1 of the power supply source.
Steps.8: Set up the multimeter as voltmeter. Ensure it is set to Auto-Range, Run/Hold and DC Voltage.
Steps.9: Connect the positive lead of the multimeter to the VCC pin of RS485 (pin 13 or 14 of the IC25) and the negative lead to GND (pin 6 or 7 of the IC25).
Steps.10: Measure with the multimeter and check if it is supplied by 3.3V.
Steps.13: Repeat the measurements with different voltages at the power supply source: 12V, 24V and 36V (using CH1 and CH2 of the power supply source connected in serial).
